tools.name: xEdit (SSEEdit)
tools.license_note: Freeware (custom license), source included; accept the risk/backup warning on first launch.
tools.verified_notes: GitHub releases/latest -> tag xedit-4.1.5f, single asset xEdit.4.1.5f.7z (31.3 MB). Listed with sevenzip.list_archive: no wrapping folder; the generic TES-family binary is xTESEdit64.exe (32-bit xTESEdit.exe also present). Confirmed via xeInit.pas (dev-4.1.6 branch) that '-sse' selects SSE mode and 'quickautoclean'/'qac' triggers QuickAutoClean, so 'xEdit64.exe' from the task brief does not exist in 4.1.x builds -- xTESEdit64.exe is correct.
